name: Blackened Skies
body:
School illusion (shadow); Level cleric/oracle 5, death mage 5, occultist 5, psychic 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, spiritualist 5, witch 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 100 ft.

Aura emanation centered on you
Duration 1 min./level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You blend your current plane with the shadow plane and shade the skies around you, nearly blotting out the sun. The entire area is considered dim light, unless it is darker, and the effects of sunlight are removed altogether. Any spell that deals damage via light is halved within the radius and any additional sunlight effects from those spells are removed.
